mentions.name: replays.lol Clipper
mentions.description: A spin off from the author's main startup's product that lets Twitch streamers review their viewers' League of Legends clips. It offers zero friction by handling clip recording itself with bots that load up people's previous games using the League of Legends game client. It launched with its first medium-size streamer and is similar to Cameo but hyper-specialized for League of Legends streamers, with plans to expand to other games and then other industries.
mentions.problem: Recording and obtaining viewers' game clips is high friction for streamers, which this service removes by handling the recording itself via automated bots.
mentions.audience: Twitch streamers (starting with medium-size League of Legends streamers, with plans to expand to other games and industries)
